prompt:
Create a polished desktop WEBSITE UI MOCKUP, landscape 1536x1024, original data-science portfolio for Archel Taneka Sutanto. This is a real readable website screen, not a poster or illustration. Evidence Index direction. Flat midnight navy #101D35, warm white #F5F3EB, cobalt #1357D6 and pale turquoise #6BE5DB. Bold condensed uppercase display type, calm upright sans-serif body. Original angled navigation framing evokes energetic Japanese menu design without any copyrighted game assets, characters, logos or icons.
Layout: a narrow 230px navy left rail with ARCHEL / PORTFOLIO at top, numbered links 01 Overview selected in white with cobalt edge, 02 Impact, 03 Projects, 04 Experience, 05 Skills, 06 Contact. Rail bottom Resume PDF link. Main white panel begins x270, ample padding. At top small PRODUCT DATA SCIENTIST. Dominant two-line name ARCHEL T. / SUTANTO, dark condensed heavy display, 85px. Below at 20px: 'Experimentation, causal inference, and product ML.' Then 'Turning models and analysis into measurable product decisions.' Primary cobalt View projects button and dark outlined Resume PDF button. Right third holds a clean framed crop of the supplied real profile photograph, preserve identity and photo content, no invented portrait. One broad simple diagonal cobalt plane behind the photo only, no decorative illustrations. Lower viewport a full-width navy professional evidence band with header SELECTED IMPACT / tiket.com. Three aligned columns: '4.8%' / 'checkout conversion lift' / 'Payment recommendation engine'; '18%' / 'reduction in bounce rate' / 'Hotel image quality classifier'; '120 → 15 hrs' / 'weekly manual review' / 'Hotel entity matching'. Below show beginning of section 'Selected work' and one text row 'DAG-nabit — causal inference'. Clear alignment, readable text, generous whitespace, crisp edges, no rounded card grid, no glow, no fake graphs, no skill ratings. This must feel professional and energetic with the data scientist and evidence doing the work.
